bullets.id: Emas bertahan di dekat $3.650 pada Selasa pagi setelah memantul dari level terendah setahun; Trading Economics mencatat sekitar $3.639 (+0,12%). Senin, spot sempat naik 2,25% ke $3.617,50 menurut Kitco, dengan rentang harian $3.539,80–$3.637,90. Saham teknologi pulih setelah Nvidia mengangkat kembali Jensen Huang sebagai CEO, sehingga tekanan jual mereda.
bullets.en: Gold held near $3,650 on Tuesday morning after bouncing from a one-year low; Trading Economics shows about $3,639 (+0.12%). On Monday, spot rose 2.25% to $3,617.50 according to Kitco, in a $3,539.80–$3,637.90 daily range. Tech stocks recovered after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, easing selling pressure.

bullets.id: Pasar masih memperkirakan sekitar 95% peluang kenaikan suku bunga Fed 25 bps pada rapat 8–9 Desember, sisanya untuk 50 bps; Gubernur Fed Christopher Waller bahkan membuka opsi kenaikan setengah poin. Dolar berada di dekat level tertinggi 20 bulan. Emas masih turun sekitar 9,4% sebulan dan sekitar 33% di bawah rekor penutupan $5.405 pada 29 Januari.
bullets.en: Markets still price about a 95% chance of a 25 bp Fed hike at the Dec. 8–9 meeting, with the rest on 50 bp; Fed Governor Christopher Waller has even floated a half-point hike. The dollar sits near 20-month highs. Gold is still down about 9.4% on the month and about 33% below its Jan. 29 record close of $5,405.

bullets.id: FXEmpire mencatat support di $3.595 lalu $3.503 (low 14 bulan), dengan resistance di $3.651 lalu $3.695. Penentu berikutnya adalah data inflasi PCE Oktober dan estimasi kedua PDB kuartal III AS, Rabu 25 November pukul 08.30 ET (20.30 WIB). PCE September tercatat 3,6% headline dan 3,1% inti secara tahunan.
bullets.en: FXEmpire lists support at $3,595 then $3,503 (the 14-month low), with resistance at $3,651 then $3,695. The next driver is the October PCE inflation report and the second estimate of US Q3 GDP, Wednesday, Nov. 25 at 8:30 a.m. ET (8:30 p.m. WIB). September PCE was 3.6% headline and 3.1% core year on year.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram naik Rp2.000 ke Rp2.507.000 dan buyback naik Rp15.000 ke Rp2.150.000, sehingga spread Rp357.000 (sekitar 14,2%). Galeri24 naik ke Rp2.351.000 (buyback Rp2.210.000) dan UBS ke Rp2.373.000 (buyback Rp2.186.000). Secara struktural, bank sentral membeli bersih 321 ton pada kuartal III 2026, naik 42% dari tahun sebelumnya.
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram bar rose Rp2,000 to Rp2,507,000 and buyback rose Rp15,000 to Rp2,150,000, for a spread of Rp357,000 (about 14.2%). Galeri24 rose to Rp2,351,000 (buyback Rp2,210,000) and UBS to Rp2,373,000 (buyback Rp2,186,000). Structurally, central banks bought a net 321 tonnes in Q3 2026, up 42% from a year earlier.
